name: Truncation Collapses Types Into Type Invalidations
description: When a cascade exceeds the server's limits, servers MUST NOT silently drop entities: every omitted entity's type MUST appear in typeInvalidations and metadata.truncated MUST be true (Mutation Responses, Cascade Size Limits and Truncation)

input.mutation: mutation PublishAuthor($id: ID!) { publishAuthor(id: $id) { success cascade { updated { __typename id } typeInvalidations { typename affectedCount } metadata { truncated affectedCount } } } }
